g.text: An identity may replace either side by the other,
NOT (X OR Y) = (NOT X) AND (NOT Y)
NOT (X AND Y) = (NOT X) OR (NOT Y)
Double negation: NOT NOT X = X
Why bother, when tables settle it?
X AND ((Y AND Z) OR NOT (Y AND Z))
and Identity gives X. Eight rows avoided.
One equation is enough, as McCune proved — with automated deduction.
